title: Mayer–Vietoris sequence for derived Hom on a two-open cover
statement: Let (X, O_X) be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] covered by open subspaces U and V, and let D(O_X) be the derived category of sheaves of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and likewise for the opens. For any two objects E and F of D(O_X), there is an exact sequence from global Hom(E,F) to the direct sum of Hom between their restrictions to U and V, then to Hom between their restrictions to the intersection; the second map is the difference of restrictions. Exactness is asserted at global Hom (with the preceding negative Ext term) and at the direct-sum term (with the difference map), as in the beginning of the Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence.

proof.text: Apply the distinguished Mayer–Vietoris triangle [lem-sc-derived-mayer-vietoris-triangle] to E. Applying the contravariant representable Hom(-,F) gives a long exact sequence by [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact], with the terms Hom_X(E,F), Hom_X(j_{U,!}E|_U) direct-sum Hom_X(j_{V,!}E|_V), and Hom_X(j_{UV,!}E|_{U intersection V},F). The connecting term immediately preceding Hom_X(E,F) is the negative Ext group on U intersection V.

source.place: Tag 08BW (cohomology-lemma-mayer-vietoris-hom), proof using Tag 08BU and Derived Categories Lemma 0149

proof.text: Use the derived extension-by-zero/restriction adjunction [lem-sc-derived-open-shriek-derived-adjunction] on each of the three open inclusions. It identifies the middle terms with Hom_U(E|_U,F|_U) direct-sum Hom_V(E|_V,F|_V), identifies the last term with Hom_{U intersection V}(E|_{U intersection V},F|_{U intersection V}), and identifies the first term with Hom_X(E,F). Under these identifications the map from the direct sum is the difference of the two restriction maps, because the first arrow of the triangle is the difference of the two extension-by-zero maps. This is exactly the asserted beginning of the Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence.
